A verdict is inherited only for an identical, certain v2 claim on the same base case and evidence key. Claims ending in UNCERTAIN are never inherited. 'manual' holds v1 manual decisions carried forward (migratedFromV1Claim) and decisions made under v2.

manual.key: citation|entry.manner|he claims that the smuggler led him and another man illegall
manual.explanation: The selected charge of INA 212(a)(6)(A)(i) requires that the subject entered the United States without inspection or at an undesignated place. The narrative indicates entry by smuggler across the Rio Grande, which is consistent with unlawful entry, but the form fields list the manner as PWA, creating a mismatch that may affect charge consistency.
manual.note: Manual (final run, claim v2): the 'mismatch' treats PWA (AFOOT) as conflicting with an illegal Rio Grande crossing; both describe entry without inspection, which is what 212(a)(6)(A)(i) depends on. Same standard as the F055 I-2 record.
